title: פלזמה סודית של רפא-אל

spec.palette: designed ramps, at most 5 steps each: bone 5, steel 3, teal 2, plasma 3, red 3, brass 2, mark 1

source: hand-placed pixels at 0 deg, every column (tools/art_host/weapons/plasma_px.py); rows turned RotSprite-style (Scale2x x3, nearest), stray pixels out, a 1 px outline; the mark upright in the overlay only
character:
WHO: a bone-white double-barrelled lab gun so secret that it carries a RED SIREN on top and a red SIGN taped on its
       side that says so; in the middle a glass CELL of cyan plasma with a lightning swirl, brass coils at both ends,
       cables sagging under it, a teal butt pad. Ambiguity as a policy: everybody can see it, nobody may mention it.
  IDLE: the cell glows and DRIPS light (a drop falls to the floor), the siren blinks now and then. CHARGE: the cell fills
        from a swirl to white, the siren turns, the bores glow and arcs jump between the barrels. FIRE: a big kick, the
        shroud vents steam, the spent cell drops out under the gun and a fresh one slides in. OVERHEAT: the cell goes
        red-hot, the siren goes mad, the gun hops from hand to hand (juggled), then he blows on it and it steams.
cell_note: a bigger cell than the contract's 64: it holds the weapon at every angle with its moving parts thrown out and the toss

equip.note: 24 ticks: up from the hip with a dark cell; at 11 the HUM: plasma fills the cell from the bottom, the siren blinks, the bores glow faintly: ready

idle.note: 1 s loop: the cell's lightning swirl crawls, the secret siren blinks twice, and a drop of light drips from the cage and falls to the floor

charge.note: 54 ticks held (0.9 s): the swirl thickens and the cell fills to white, the siren turns, the bores glow, at coil_1 (18) arcs jump across the vent seam, at coil_2 (36) the bores go white; ready on the last frame (held there until the release fires)

fire.note: 30 ticks: tick 0 the bolt (a white flash at the upper bore, the cell blazes), the kick back and up peaking at 3; at 6 the shroud VENTS (steam rises from the seam); at 12 the spent cell DROPS OUT under the gun and falls; at 22 a fresh cell fills the cage from the bottom, the siren blinks: ready

overheat.note: 90 ticks, its RELOAD SHOW: at 0 the cell goes red-hot with a white core, the siren goes mad; at 12 the JUGGLE: too hot to hold, it hops up and down and swings as he passes it from hand to hand; at 50 he BLOWS ON IT: the cell cools through red to cyan as steam rises; ready

empty.note: 12 ticks: the click on a dead cell (the glass goes dark, the siren dies), a droop; at 6 he tosses it away in front of him, nose down, the tag trailing

catch.note: the hand-off from the unarmed catch (catch.json has the body's frames): it lands dark in his hands, hums, the cell fills, the siren blinks; the reveal from the last frame

aim_note: a frame's aim = degrees the weapon turns from its rest (the idle's first frame is 0), added to the body's aim; kick = [px along the barrel (negative = back), px up, degrees up]
mark: the made-in-Israel mark as a SMALL HANGING TAG (the Host 12.11: at most 9 x 11, the beta's pattern): an ivory luggage tag with the blue outline star 7 x 7 on a 3 px blue-and-white cord from a swivel under the lower barrel, 30 px ahead of the grip; upright and whole in every row, swinging by whole pixels with the shot, the cell change and the toss. In atlas_mark.png ONLY (the Host's ruling)
mark_rect_note: per angle row, per column: [x, y, w, h] of the mark in the cell (the 9 x 11 tag, or the 11 x 11 roundel) and mark_star = the top-left pixel of the star (7 x 7 on the tag, 9 x 9 on a roundel); atlas_mark.png holds the mark alone in the same layout

events.hum: the cell fills (equip 11): a rising hum
events.ready: the act is over on this frame's last tick
events.shot: the bolt (fire 0): FX's plasma bolt from `muzzle` (the upper bore); trauma scaled by the charge
events.vent: steam from the seam (fire 6): a hiss
events.mag_out: the spent cell drops out under the gun (fire 12): a glassy clunk; FX may spawn a cooling cell on the floor
events.mag_in: the fresh cell fills the cage (fire 22): a rising whine
events.overheat: the cell red-hot, the siren mad (overheat 0)
events.juggle: too hot to hold (overheat 12): a 'ow ow ow'
events.blow_on_it: he blows on it (overheat 50): a long hiss
events.click: the trigger on a dead cell (empty 0)
events.toss: the spent gun leaves his hand (empty 6)
events.reveal: RENDER fires the reveal from this pose

normal_note: by plane: every colour paints one plane of the weapon (top, front, underside ...), turned with the row; silhouette pixels face out along the edge; the upright mark faces the viewer

holds.note: THE SET'S OWN CARRY per hero body pose (the Host 12.11: a hero's face is never covered by his weapon in any pose). While the king plays one of these body animations with this weapon, draw the weapon at `aim` (degrees, the body's hand aim replaced) and its hand point moved by `offset` [x, y] px; the frame's own aim delta and kick still add. His port carry (aim 25-40) puts a long weapon across his chin and mouth; a low hip carry at -20 keeps the face and the crown clear (picture: art/weapons/host/previews/king_carry_long_weapons.png).

muzzle_note: the upper bore's mouth, per row and column: the bolt starts here; the bores glow from charge 0 and go white at coil_2

glow.note: the plasma's own colours as drawn in the cell and the bores: cyan bolt, white core; red when overheated

cells: the canopy flat on the floor
sprites.anchor: the cell's TOP-left at `at` (frame px; the sprite stands on the cell's bottom, centred)

catch.note: the weapon's side of the unarmed set's catch, on the same ticks and hand points as the shotgun's catch.json (the body is one builder's): frames 0-2 it comes down, 3 the catch (its grip lands on the hand), 3-4 what carried it lets go, 5-6 in the hands, 7-9 held up behind his head (layer back), the reveal from 9. Its carrier is the parachute: on the catch it folds, then lies on the floor.
